checks.detail: Report includes ASA-style caution that p-values are not effect size or practical importance.
Standard-table runner is not a complex-survey variance engine.
bound_standard_table: This run is bound to method/spec evidence and can support local methods review for non-survey standard-table analyses.
Diagnostic run records reference-standard and index-test roles through variables and level metadata.
Confusion matrix, sensitivity, and specificity are available.
PPV/NPV are paired with prevalence so the report can state their sample-prevalence dependence.
Generated diagnostic reports state that local accuracy estimates do not justify clinical screening recommendations or deployment.
Wilson binomial intervals are available for sensitivity, specificity, PPV, and NPV.
At least one diagnostic cell is sparse; diagnostic metrics may be unstable.
